products.name: 2 Litre Hand Pressure Sprayer
products.description:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW

2 Litre Hand Pressure Sprayer (2 litre tank) Not every spraying job needs a knapsack on your back. This Made-in-Kenya 2 litre hand pump pressure sprayer is a simple, dependable tool for small jobs around the garden, farm and home. It has a clear tank marked from 500 ml to 1750 ml, a steel pump rod and an adjustable brass nozzle, and it is sold as 1 sprayer. KEY FEATURES • 2 litre tank with clear sides, so you can see the level at a glance • Measuring marks from 500 ml to 1750 ml for mixing small volumes • Steel pump rod built for repeated pumping • Adjustable brass nozzle to change the spray pattern for the job • Compact and light enough to carry in one hand • Made in Kenya • Sold as 1 sprayer and delivered to all 47 counties SPECIFICATIONS • Product: 2 Litre Hand Pressure Sprayer • Type: hand pump pressure sprayer • Tank: 2 litres, clear, marked from 500 ml to 1750 ml • Pump rod: steel • Nozzle: adjustable, brass • Origin: Made in Kenya • Sold as: 1 sprayer (1 piece) WHERE IT HELPS The sprayer suits garden pests, foliar feeds, disinfectants and household pest control. Its small size makes it handy for kitchen gardens, flower beds, nurseries, greenhouse corners, small poultry or livestock houses and spot treatments where a large knapsack sprayer would be too much. A small tank also lets you mix only what the job needs. HOW TO USE IT Fill the tank to the level you need, using the marks on the side, and add your product as directed on its label. Do not fill above the top mark, because the tank needs air space to build pressure. Close the cap firmly, pump the handle until you feel resistance, then spray evenly, moving steadily so that every surface is covered. Pump again when the spray weakens. BEFORE YOU START • Read the label of the product you plan to spray, and mix only the volume you need • Check that the cap closes firmly and the nozzle is clear • Where possible, use a separate sprayer for herbicides to avoid contaminating other crops SAFETY Wear gloves, a mask and eye protection when spraying chemicals, and release the pressure before opening the cap. Never eat, drink or smoke while spraying. Keep the sprayer and any chemical away from children. STORAGE Rinse the tank and nozzle with clean water after every use so that residue does not block the nozzle, then store the sprayer clean and dry, out of direct sun and away from children. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS What size is the tank? It holds 2 litres. The clear tank is marked from 500 ml to 1750 ml, so you can see the level and mix small volumes. What can I spray with it? Garden pests, foliar feeds, disinfectants and household pest control products, each as its own label directs. Why should I not fill it to the top? The tank needs air space to build pressure, so fill it only to the top mark. How do I keep the nozzle from blocking? Rinse the tank and nozzle with clean water after every use so that residue does not dry inside. products.name: Jacto HD 550 Knapsack Sprayer
products.description:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Jacto HD 550 Knapsack Sprayer (20 litres) A sprayer is one of the most used tools on a farm, and a weak one wastes product and time. The Jacto HD 550 is a heavy-duty manual knapsack sprayer with a 20 litre tank. It has a piston pump, an internal agitator, a reinforced hose and an adjustable nozzle for spraying pesticides, herbicides and foliar fertilizers on farms and gardens, and for pest control. KEY FEATURES • Heavy-duty manual knapsack sprayer • 20 litre tank • Piston pump • Internal agitator • Reinforced hose • Adjustable nozzle • For pesticides, herbicides and foliar fertilizers • For farms, gardens and pest control SPECIFICATIONS • Brand: Jacto • Model: HD 550 • Type: manual knapsack sprayer • Tank capacity: 20 litres • Pump: piston pump • Agitator: internal • Hose: reinforced WHERE IT HELPS A strong, well-built sprayer gives more even coverage, lasts through many seasons and wastes less product. The Jacto HD 550 is designed for repeated, regular use by commercial growers, farm workers and spraying contractors as well as home gardeners. The piston pump builds pressure with each stroke of the lever, which gives a steady spray. The internal agitator stirs the mixture as you pump, which helps keep products that settle, such as suspensions and powders, evenly mixed. The reinforced hose is made to take pressure and daily handling, and the adjustable nozzle changes the spray pattern from fine coverage on leaves to a more directed spray. HOW TO USE IT Fill the tank to the level you need, add the product at the rate on its label, close the lid and pump to build pressure. Spray evenly and walk at a steady pace. Calibrate your sprayer so that you know how much it delivers over a given area, and use that figure to work out how much product goes into each tank. It sprays pesticides, herbicides and foliar fertilizers on crops, orchards, flower farms and gardens, and it is used for pest control around homes, stores and compounds. BEFORE YOU START • Where possible, use a separate sprayer for herbicides to avoid contamination • Check the seals and the hose for leaks • Clean the nozzle and the filter SAFETY Wear gloves, a mask, goggles and protective clothing when spraying, and follow the product label. Do not spray in windy weather. Do not eat, drink or smoke while spraying. Release the pressure before opening the lid, and keep the sprayer away from children. STORAGE Rinse the tank, hose and nozzle with clean water after every use, clean the nozzle and filter regularly, and store the sprayer clean and dry, away from direct sun and children. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Is the Jacto HD 550 manual or motorised? It is a manual knapsack sprayer with a piston pump, so it is pumped by hand with the lever. What does the internal agitator do? It stirs the mixture inside the tank as you pump, which helps keep products that settle, such as suspensions and powders, evenly mixed. Can I use it for herbicides and pesticides? Yes. It is made for pesticides, herbicides and foliar fertilizers. Where possible, keep a separate sprayer for herbicides to avoid contamination. products.name: Total 20L Knapsack Sprayer 4.5Bar
products.description:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Total 20L Knapsack Sprayer 4.5Bar (20 Litre) A good chemical is wasted if your sprayer drips, clogs or gives uneven coverage. The Total 20L Knapsack Sprayer (THSPP42002) carries a full 20 litre tank on your back, builds pressure up to 4.5 bar with the hand lever, and lets you switch the nozzle from a tight jet to a fine mist. It suits crop spraying, weed control, livestock-house disinfection and pest control around the home. KEY BENEFITS • 20 litre tank covers more ground per fill, with fewer refill trips • Adjustable nozzle: jet for reach, fine mist for even leaf coverage • Y-shaped trigger with a fibreglass lance that is light and corrosion-resistant • Light at about 2.6 kg, so it is comfortable to carry • Compatible with the insecticides, herbicides and disinfectants in our store WHERE YOU CAN USE IT • Crop protection sprays on vegetables, fruits and field crops • Weed control in fields and around buildings • Disinfecting poultry houses, livestock sheds and farm premises • Pest control sprays around the home and compound The larger tank is especially useful on bigger plots, where stopping often to refill wastes time and breaks your rhythm. MIXING AND APPLICATION GUIDE (20 L TANK) 1. Fill the tank about half full with clean water. 2. Add the measured chemical, then top up to the 20 L mark and shake well. 3. Pump to a steady working pressure. Do not exceed 4.5 bar. 4. Calibrate once: spray 20 L over a measured plot so you know how much ground one tank covers. Always follow the label of the chemical you are using for the dose, the timing and the re-entry period. CARE After each use, empty the tank, rinse it and spray clean water through the hose and lance. Keep a separate sprayer for herbicides if you can, since glyphosate residue can damage crops later. Check the nozzle and seals regularly, and store the sprayer in a shaded, dry place. SAFETY Wear gloves, a mask, overalls and boots whenever you spray, and never use the tank for drinking water. Keep chemicals and the sprayer away from children. TECHNICAL SPECS • Model: Total THSPP42002 • Capacity: 20 litres • Operating pressure: 1.5 to 4.5 bar • Power: manual (hand pump) • Lance: fibreglass, with Y-trigger • Weight: about 2.6 kg • Packaging: colour box WHAT'S IN THE BOX 1 × Total THSPP42002 20L knapsack sprayer with Y-trigger and fibreglass lance FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Is it electric?
